fusions.name: Row of Spires
fusions.desc: Stone spires erupt across a 4-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and throwing it back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Toppled Pinnacle
fusions.desc: Topples a stone pinnacle onto the first enemy it meets for 30 damage. It shatters for 80% of that on everything within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: True North
fusions.desc: Up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spalling
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: stone splinters strike the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
